calls.statement:
SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS dist_orders, MIN(o.order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS orders,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN o.web_order_id END) AS test_orders,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN o.web_order_id END) AS s999,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN o.web_order_id END) AS no_lines
FROM fact_web_order o
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE o.status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-12-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) utc_day_count FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-30' AND DATE '2025-12-02'
